study_identification_part.si4_title: Normative trajectories of R1, R2*, and magnetic susceptibility in basal ganglia on healthy ageing

study_characteristics_part.sc1_study_objective: Establish normative trajectories across adulthood for qMRI parameters R1, R2*, and magnetic susceptibility (χ) in basal ganglia (and thalamic subnuclei), assess spatial gradients, and validate the utility of these trajectories including application to Parkinson's disease.

clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa7_association_analysis: Two-sample t-tests comparing z-scores and median qMRI values between PD and controls with FDR correction (Benjamini–Hochberg).
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa8_key_findings_brief: Normative models revealed inverted-U R1 and near-linear R2*/χ trajectories; external PPP validation reproduced PD-related increases in substantia nigra, supporting clinical utility of qMRI-based normative deviations.
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa9_key_findings_detailed: Using ABRIM (N=260) we modeled ROI-level and thalamic subnuclei trajectories: R1 showed inverted-U with peaks ~50–65 years, while R2* and χ were largely linear. GPR z-scores showed strong interrelation between R2* and χ and weaker with R1. Applying ABRIM-derived models to PPP (controls N=44; PD N=316) reproduced higher R2* and χ in substantia nigra subregions in PD; more regions reached p<0.001 when increasing control sample size. Spatial gradients in putamen/caudate showed age-dependent patterns.

caa10_key_limitations.answer: Potential bias from differing age distributions between groups; limited ABRIM sample may under-capture variance at some ages (zig-zag CIs); study-specific acquisition/processing may limit generalizability; pooled hemispheres may obscure hemisphere-specific maturation.
caa10_key_limitations.supporting_text: "... differences in the age distributions ... would introduce a bias ..."; "... may not have sufficient data in the ABRIM dataset to accurately capture the true variance ... zig-zag pattern of the 95% CI ..."; "... derived models ... may not hold universal validity across different studies ... variations in acquisition parameters ... vendor hardware ... pipeline ... introduce study biases ... harmonisation procedures ..."; "... we pooled the subcortical nuclei from the left and right hemispheres ... future studies ... trajectories ... from different hemispheres could be studied separately ..."

clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa11_application_notes: ROI median used to reduce partial volume sensitivity; hybrid image contrast matching integrated into SEPIA to improve atlas-based parcellation; explored spatial gradients (L–M, P–A, I–S) in putamen/caudate.

general_note_part.gn1_general_notes: Validation used PPP with similar protocol; for PPP patients, only baseline scan included. Data and pipeline scripts publicly available (ABRIM DOI; PPP access via agreement).
